notes.title: Kemono Heroes is just released on Switch!
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce that we have partnered with Nippon Ichi Software and NIS America to release our new game, Kemono Heroes, world wide on Nintendo Switch :D

[previewyoutube=idEu0cmxzIg;leftthumb]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=idEu0cmxzIg[/previewyoutube]After 3 years of development and playtesting, we are confident that people of all ages will enjoy our game! 

Select your preferred difficulty level, from the most hardcore to the easiest for young heroes.

Choose your favourite fluffy ninja hero and save the world from Tsukigami and the yokai hordes, solo or with 3 friends! :D

notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28118973/8f89b50e8d92e4c0c52718ffb4eba782582fe987.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! :D

[b]A Hole New World version 1.1[/b] has just been released! 

This version includes some bugfixes and improvements in controller support, as well as complete translations for Russian and Polish. Big thanks to [i]Dmitry Aleksov[/i] from EmuGamer for his Russian translation and to [i]Grzegorz 'Skay' Fedkiewicz[/i] for his Polish translation! :D

[b]Changelog for version 1.1:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added cyrillic pixel font
    [*]Added Russian language localization
    [*]Added Polish special characters to latin pixel font
    [*]Added Polish language localization
    [*]Updated controller plugin version
    [*]Fix: Potion Master no longer can receive a "double damage combo" (it normally ocurred against Baduk)
    [*]Fix: Cursor is now automatically hidden when over the game window
    [*]Fix: Missing Backers (the ones who answered after the release of the game) Added into credits 
[/list]

Right now you can play A Hole New World in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish and Russian! ^^ 
Is it still not in your language? If you would like to translate it, feel free to write us! ;)

Cheers!

notes.title: Now on PS4!!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28118973/c6720ba8743724ea45f2dd64d4d5eeed68ca888e.jpg[/img]

After releasing on Windows, Mac, Linux and Xbox One, finally, [b]A Hole New World is available on PS4[/b]! :D

https://youtu.be/U3HMxzuZdWg
And we are celebrating the same way we did with the Xbox version: Awarding [b]3 limited A Hole New World’s OST NES cartridges[/b], that will play the fantastic soundtrack of the game on actual 30 years old NES hardware, [b]to the first 3 to unlock all trophies and contact us[/b].  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28118973/bd127e92577006ccce576a857200f5c9aa3b45e7.jpg[/img]

And also, while the Xbox One units went already away, [b]there are still some places available[/b] for those who want to enter the [b]Super Early Access[/b] of our next game [url=http://www.madgeargames.com/kh/]Kemono Heroes[/url] for free. The winners will be able to help us improving the game while we are developing it. Just beat the “Good Ending” or the "Game+ Ending" of A Hole New World on Steam ("FIN!" or "FIN+" achievements), and tell us! ;)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28118973/80f7bdb80554a77cb304e06daef88151d1a2e62e.jpg[/img]
